chunks: He will say: 'Remain condemned in it, and do not speak to Me.'
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when Allah says 'Exhaust yourselves in it' to the people of Hell?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this command signifies the finality of divine judgment where the disbelievers are stripped of their rhetorical defenses and intercessors, reflecting the concept of 'khusr' (loss/humiliation) as a permanent state. It underscores the severance of communication between the guilty and the Judge, marking the end of the era of trial and the beginning of eternal retribution.
